visual_identity.core_identity: A nearly transparent cube-shaped dungeon ooze whose straight corridor-filling edges and suspended debris make its body readable.
visual_identity.silhouette: Large rectangular cube occupying most of a ten-foot corridor, with subtly rippling edges and a flat forward face.
visual_identity.head_features: No head or face; identity comes entirely from the cube form and suspended contents.
visual_identity.body_shape: Uniform gelatinous cube with faint internal bubbles and objects suspended at different depths.
visual_identity.surface: Mostly clear open white interior with only sparse contour ripples and bubbles.
